full_judgment: 19. The learned Advocate for the respondent then cited the case of Bikram Kishore Chakma vs Member, Land Appeal Board and others, reported in 6 BLC 436 and submits that in that case it was held that there is nothing in the Act 24 of 1989 and the rules made thereunder that the law and the rules will not be applicable to Chittagong Hill Tracts and hence it will be applicable to Chittagong Hill Tracts notwithstanding the provision in the Chittagong Hill Tracts Regulation. The case reported in 6 BLC 436 arises out of a dispute over settlement of Government khas land within Chittagong Hill District and the matter before us is with regard to civil suit for specific performance of contract which the Deputy Commissioner, Rangamati Hill District disposed of as civil Court under Regulation 7 of Chittagong Hill Tracts Regulation 1990. So, in our view the facts of this case are distinguishable from the facts of the present case.
